clean.replaced_with: the imported page image at the recording's frame size, page aspect kept, padded

rules.confident_match: a deck page matched with at least --min-confidence: the page replaces the capture
rules.low_confidence: a deck page matched, but below --min-confidence: the capture is kept
rules.mixed: the segment's frames showed different pages: the capture is kept
rules.unmatched: no deck page matched: the capture is kept

deck.text_normalisation: CRLF/CR -> LF; control characters other than LF and TAB dropped; Unicode NFC; CJK radicals (U+2E80-U+2FDF) -> NFKC (e.g. U+2F47 -> U+65E5); trailing spaces of each line and blank lines at both ends removed

execution.converter: LibreOffice soffice for pptx / ppt / key / odp (argv only, a fresh temporary profile, run on a copy of the deck)
execution.engine: ffmpeg-skill (scripts run with this Python, argv only)
execution.overwrites: never unless --overwrite; -o equal to the input is refused

follow.closed_when: the file's size and mtime unchanged for --settle seconds
follow.final_when: at least min_dwell + 1s before the end of what could be read
follow.output: JSON lines: start, pass, waiting, change, retract, done (done carries the timeline)
follow.readable_while_growing: containers whose length ffmpeg-skill probe measures as they grow (MPEG-TS: .ts, .m2ts, .mts); others report their changes when they close

insert.shift: every segment after an insertion moves later by the clip's measured duration

rules.after_last_deck_page: after the last matched deck page (the talk is over: Q&A)
rules.before_first_deck_page: before the first matched deck page (the talk has not started)
rules.camera_not_covering: the speaker camera does not cover this time: the slide picture is kept
rules.deck_page: a deck page is on screen
rules.deck_page_no_side_band: a deck page is on screen; --slides side, but the slide leaves no free band wide enough
rules.deck_page_side_band: a deck page is on screen and the slide leaves a free band at the side
rules.no_camera: no speaker camera given: the slide picture is kept
rules.no_deck_page: no segment of the recording matched a deck page
rules.slides_full: a deck page is on screen; --slides full
rules.unmatched_mid_talk_kept: no deck page matched between matched pages (a demo, a backup slide, a blank): the slide picture is kept

layout.steps: ffmpeg-skill overlay (--video --place) for PiP / side by side, broll for speaker full; overlay --place needs ffmpeg-skill 2.13.0 or later

match.unmatched: page null with reason below_min_score or ambiguous

not_provided: slide text from images or scanned pages (OCR: detection-skill)
matching by slide text (OCR of the frames is detection-skill's; match compares pictures)
running ffmpeg or ffprobe directly (only through ffmpeg-skill)
editing the picture or cutting the talk beyond splicing clips in at slide boundaries and the slide / speaker layout (video-editing-skill)
syncing the speaker camera to the recording (the offset is given; multicam sync is ffmpeg-skill's)
live streaming or live switching (recorded files only)

tools.description: Slide changes of a talk recording: one entry per slide (start, end, duration), from ffmpeg-skill scenes. With --follow, of a recording still being written: slide changes as JSON lines as they are found, then the timeline once the file has settled
Chapters from a slide timeline: chapter text (YouTube description format) and, with -o, a copy of the video carrying them as container chapters (ffmpeg-skill metadata, streams copied)

Slide deck to one PNG and one text per page plus a deck.json manifest (slide-sync/deck@1). PDF through pypdfium2 (optional extra 'pdf'); pptx / ppt / key / odp converted to PDF by LibreOffice when installed

Which page of an imported deck is on screen in each slide of a timeline (slide-sync/match@1): page, confidence and margin per segment by image correlation of frames (ffmpeg-skill look) with the page images, or page null with the reason when no page is clearly best. Order need not follow the deck

Splice clips into a recording at slide boundaries (a demo video as it is, an image as a still clip): ffmpeg-skill probe / insert / cut --accurate / join --transition none, then the shifted timeline's chapters through metadata. Every slide after an insertion moves later by the clip's measured length; the timeline (provenance DERIVED) records each edit

A layout per segment of a slide talk from match (slide full, the speaker camera picture-in-picture on the slide, side by side in the band beside a pillarboxed slide, the speaker full during Q&A), with the rule used per segment, written as a plan of ffmpeg-skill overlay / broll calls (slide-sync/layout@1); with -o the plan is rendered

The deck page, sharp and at the recording's frame size, over the captured slide for the time match is confident about it (slide-sync/clean@1: replace or keep and the rule per segment, ffmpeg-skill insert per page then one broll); a low-confidence, mixed or unmatched segment keeps the capture; with -o the plan is rendered
